_comment: Identity-port ACL (custody X-1 step 1, W3; ADR-2122; closed operation list per ADR-2101 :110-111).
Loaded once by `nostr-pod-bridge serve-identity` (AGENTBOX_IDENTITY_ACL). Authorisation is the caller's
uid from SO_PEERCRED, never the socket mode. Callers are keyed by numeric uid; `name` is for receipts only.
uids follow design §2.2 (960 identity, 961 gateway, 962 ingress, 963 spend); W1's role registry is authoritative.
Key files live under AGENTBOX_IDENTITY_KEY_DIR (default /run/secrets/ab-identity, W1's delivery dir; file names are the
variable names, as W2's role_secret readers expect). AGENTBOX_PRIVKEY_HEX must hold the
operator hex exactly as AGENTBOX_PRIVKEY_HEX supplies it (not the even-y normalised scalar): the mirror child
is derived from it (src/mirror_key.rs), and an odd-y house key would otherwise hand the phone a different key.
`manifest:a.b.c` resolves from /etc/agentbox.toml at start; an unresolved reference grants nothing.
Kinds 27235, 22242, 31400-31405 and 38414 cannot be granted (the loader refuses the file).
mirror_key `secret: true` returns the live-mirror CHILD secret (the key the phone holds) because
config/hooks/nostr-live-mirror.cjs:487 signs the self-DM wrap with it; the sovereign secret never crosses.
